title: Local shifted dualizing lines and normalized section-chart comparisons
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $N\geq1$ with $NA=0$, and let $S$ be Noetherian with $N$ invertible on $S$. Work in the ordinary unbounded categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ of constant-$A$ module sheaves, with exact inverse images. For every compactifiable structural map $b$ write $\omega_b=b^\times A$ using the right adjoint of $Rb_!$. Put $A_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}A_T$ and $A_T(d)=A_T(1)^{\otimes d}$, with $A_T(0)=A_T$.
Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme (one admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings), let $d\geq0$, and let $g:V\to S$ be smooth, separated and of finite type of pure relative dimension $d$, with a closed section $s:S\hookrightarrow V$, $g s=1_S$.
For the ideal $\mathcal I$ of $s(S)$ set $\mathcal E=\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2$, $\pi:N_s=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_S\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal E)\to S$, with zero section $z$. Set $D_sV=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_V\mathcal O_V[t,\mathcal I/t]$, using the subalgebra of $\mathcal O_V[t,t^{-1}]$ generated by $t$ and the $b/t$, $b\in\mathcal I$. Its structural map is $q:D_sV\to\mathbf A^1_S$ and its section $\sigma$ is the augmentation $t\mapsto t$, $\mathcal I/t\mapsto0$, with coefficients restricted by $s$.
Assume $g,q,\pi$ are compactifiable and that $D_sV$ is Noetherian, $q$ is smooth separated of dimension $d$, with the canonical pairs $(g,s)$ at $1$ and $(\pi,z)$ at $0$. Write $a:\mathbf A^1_S\to S$, $C=s^*\omega_g$, $F=\sigma^*\omega_q$. Then $C[-2d]$ and $F[-2d]$ are locally constant sheaves, etale locally free of rank one. The counit-defined exceptional base-change maps give isomorphisms
$$\theta:i_1^*F\xrightarrow{\sim}C,\qquad\eta:i_0^*F\xrightarrow{\sim}z^*\omega_\pi.$$
On each affine centred etale coordinate neighbourhood $e_i:U_i\to\mathbf A^d_{S_i}$ whose square of centres is Cartesian, the right-adjoint locality maps and the affine-space adjunction identify $C|_{S_i}$ with $A_{S_i}(d)[2d]$ and $F|_{\mathbf A^1_{S_i}}$ with $A_{\mathbf A^1_{S_i}}(d)[2d]$. Thus there is an isomorphism $\lambda_i:F|_{\mathbf A^1_{S_i}}\to a_i^*(C|_{S_i})$ obtained from these two identifications and Tate pullback. If $h_i=(i_1^*\lambda_i)\theta_i^{-1}$, then
$$\lambda_i^{\mathrm{norm}}=a_i^*(h_i^{-1})\lambda_i,\qquad i_1^*\lambda_i^{\mathrm{norm}}=\theta_i.$$
All comparisons here are in the ordinary etale categories; the locality maps compare adjunctions by their counits, and no arbitrary fibre identification is substituted.
The scheme, morphism, algebra and coefficient notation and the specified comparison maps are those of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], [def-sbc-affine-space], [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section], [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra], [def-asd-compactifiable], [def-weil-etale-morphism], [cor-amb-affine-space-adjunction], [lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality].
